containers.name: openbao

command:
KEY_DIR="/vault/userconfig/unseal-key"
while true; do
  if [ ! -f "$KEY_DIR/unseal-key-1" ]; then
    echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] Unseal key secret not mounted yet, waiting..."
    sleep 30
    continue
  fi
  HEALTH=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/sys/health 2>/dev/null || true)
  SEALED=$(echo "$HEALTH" | grep -o '"sealed":[a-z]*' | cut -d: -f2)
  if [ "$SEALED" = "true" ]; then
    echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] OpenBao sealed — submitting 3 unseal shares..."
    for i in 1 2 3; do
      KEY=$(cat "$KEY_DIR/unseal-key-$i")
      curl -sf -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:8200/v1/sys/unseal \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "{\"key\":\"$KEY\"}" > /dev/null && \
        echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] Share $i submitted"
    done
  fi
  sleep 10
done
containers.name: auto-unseal
